note: The independent 2005 Compendium and 2018 St. Joseph College Seminary Vade Mecum witnesses agree on all 52 substantive words, their order and the complete prayer boundary. Their differences are confined to stress accents, ae/æ and oe/œ typography, capitalization of second-person forms, lineation and punctuation handled by substantive-only comparison. The corpus follows the controlling Compendium's accented house typography and introduces six sense-based segment stops without changing syntax. The distinct 1974 Ordo paenitentiae formula is excluded rather than conflated under the shared title.
